title: If applicable, allow using "Alternatives" functionality to select new widget for any old incompatible Plasma 5 widgets still installed after Plasma 6 update
line: Right-clicking a widget that can't load, like an old Plasma 5 launcher, now offers Show Alternatives, so it can be swapped for a working one in the same spot with its settings kept.
explanation: ContainmentItem::addAppletActions() only added the Show Alternatives action for applets that loaded, so a widget showing the "not compatible with Plasma 6" placeholder offered nothing but removing it, which throws its config away. On top of that, Plasma 5 widgets that only ship a metadata.desktop file had their metadata converted without X-Plasma-Provides, so even the panel edit-mode Alternatives button had nothing to match against. The menu now adds Show Alternatives for failed applets too (Configure stays hidden for them), and the applet package structure keeps X-Plasma-Provides when converting legacy metadata.desktop files. Picking an alternative goes through the existing swap, which puts the new widget in the same place and copies the old widget's config.

commits.message:
plasmaquick: offer Show Alternatives for widgets that failed to load

Widgets that fail to load, like Plasma 5 ones after upgrading, offered
no Show Alternatives, so replacing them lost their config. Offer it for
them too, and keep X-Plasma-Provides from legacy metadata.desktop files.

BUG: 497551

media.caption: Right-click on an old Plasma 5 launcher widget (metadata.json, provides org.kde.plasma.launchermenu) that fails to load: no Show Alternatives
Same widget with the fix: Show Alternatives is offered
Plasma 5 launcher with only a metadata.desktop file (gamepad icon): the right-click menu has no way to replace it
Same widget with the fix: Show Alternatives lists the launchers, picking Application Launcher replaces it in the same spot

reviews.text: Offering Show Alternatives for failed-to-load widgets in ContainmentItem::addAppletActions() and preserving X-Plasma-Provides for legacy metadata.desktop packages cleanly enables replacing incompatible Plasma 5 widgets in place with config preserved. However, after-2.mp4 reveals a concrete regression/UX bug: because incompatible Plasma 5 widgets are not filtered out of the Alternatives list, preserving X-Plasma-Provides on legacy metadata.desktop packages now causes broken Plasma 5 widgets to appear as selectable alternatives (with no incompatibility warning) even on working Plasma 6 widgets, allowing users to switch into a broken widget.
changes: Filter out incompatible widgets (e.g. Plasma 5 applets that fail the API version compatibility check) from the selectable alternatives shown in the Alternatives dialog (e.g. in plasma-workspace's AlternativesHelper / AppletAlternatives), so users can switch away from an incompatible widget but are never offered another incompatible widget to switch to.
Ensure the alternatives action is only enabled when at least one compatible alternative exists, rather than enabling it when only other incompatible widgets share X-Plasma-Provides.
